applicabilityBasis.summary: The verified Hemi VCRED source describes a stablecoin pegged to the U.S. dollar, but owner-controlled minting and standard ERC20 burns do not establish an issuer obligation to redeem, convert or repurchase for a fixed monetary amount. The current VCRED website describes AI/perpetuals-vault access and does not identify this Hemi deployment's legal issuer or redemption contract. Payment-stablecoin applicability under section 2(22) remains unresolved.

references.label: GENIUS Act section 2(22) payment stablecoin definition

genius.notes: No token-specific reserve disclosure, contractual redemption policy or monthly attestation was found in the reviewed public materials. VCRED Ltd is a website copyright label, not a verified legal issuer of the exact Hemi stablecoin; issuerEntity and domicile are omitted. The website's staking/vault marketing is not enough to classify the Hemi token as a NAV receipt share, and ordinary burns do not establish dollar redemption. Federal proposals and the SCRC procedural rule do not constitute an issuer approval. No present GENIUS offer/sale restriction naming this token was found; all negative statements describe a dated finite review.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS approval, state qualification, issuer-specific application, foreign registration or GENIUS enforcement action naming VCRED was found in the reviewed sources. No exact legal issuer is identified, so the review cannot rule out an unpublished or differently named entity relationship. Current federal framework proposals and existing NYDFS licenses must not be confused with token-specific GENIUS authorization.
